The '''1948–49 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 4th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams.

[[Kjøbenhavns Boldklub]] successfully defended its [[1947-48 Danish 1st Division|1948 title]] in its successive pursuit of the 1949 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1948/1949 season.
